theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [Bialgebra k H] (D : Subalgebra k H) (_hΔ : ∀ x ∈ D, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ D, ∃ b ∈ D, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b}), ∃ δ : D →ₐ[k] TensorProduct k D D, ∀ d : D, (Algebra.TensorProduct.map D.val D.val) (δ d) = Coalgebra.comul (R := k) (d : H)
